text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer. It's fine already.
Just give up on winning it."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
We can still see it through the case anyway.
That was the plan from the start, right?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I get your enthusiasm, loud and clear.
Now come on, let the next person have a turn.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It ended in a disappointing result...
